newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end at 24.50pct, shrug off taxes.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end at 24.50pct, shrug off taxes.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed near their opening levels on Monday as tax payments had little impact on the market, dealers said.
Overnight rates ended at 24.50 percent, above the opening rate of 24 percent, but below the day's peak of 25 percent and also below Friday's close of 25.00/25.50 percent.
Dealers said tax payments did not influence the market substantially because fresh money was arriving to the market following the expiry of reverse repo deals.
"Money that banks placed to one-month reverse repo deals late last year is expiring and a huge amount money is coming back to the market," said Balazs Varga of Inter-Europa Bank.
Banks placed most of their excess funds in one-week and one-month reverse repo deals at the end of 1996 when overnight rates were below 20 percent.
"I expect a downward trend (of interest rates) this week although this does not mean we'll go below 20 percent but I predict interest rates easing to between 22 and 23 percent tomorrow."
